relationships.evidence_quote: Migraine frequency and disability gradually increased after mAbs anti-CGRP interruption.

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: Our data demonstrated that their therapeutic effect does not outlast after discontinuation in most patients even after a long-term, i.e., one-year, treatment.

key_findings: After 1 year of erenumab/galcanezumab, discontinuation led to gradual rise in MMDs, acute medication use and disability over 3 months, though still below baseline.
Relapse to CM occurred in 46.4% and to medication overuse in 42.3% at 3 months; response persistence correlated with magnitude of response in last treatment month.
